name: Data Compare
description: Compares two versions of a dataset by key: added, removed and changed records, field-level differences with tolerances, and schema differences.
introductoryText:
Compares two versions of a dataset (before and after a migration, source and target, last month's extract and this month's) and shows exactly what changed.

- Records are matched on **key fields** (for example Customer ID); without keys, whole rows are matched
- Each record is **Added**, **Removed**, **Changed** or **Unchanged**, with the list of changed fields
- One row per **changed value** with old and new value and the numeric change
- A **field summary**: how many values changed per field, field types on each side, and fields that exist on one side only
- **Tolerances** for numbers (absolute and relative), and options to ignore case, trim spaces and treat blank text as null, so cosmetic differences do not drown out real ones
- **Duplicate keys** are reported and left out of the comparison rather than matched arbitrarily

Connect the old (before) data to input 1 and the new (after) data to input 2.

options.name: key_fields
options.title: Key fields
options.description: Identify a record in both inputs. Leave empty to match whole rows.

options.name: compare_fields
options.title: Fields to compare (optional)
options.description: Default: all fields in both inputs except keys and ignored fields.

options.name: tolerance
options.title: Numeric tolerance
options.description: Differences up to this amount are not changes.

options.name: relative_tolerance
options.title: Relative tolerance
options.description: For example 0.001 = 0.1% of the old value.

options.name: ignore_case
options.title: Ignore case
options.description: Text that differs only in upper and lower case is not a change.

options.name: trim
options.title: Trim spaces
options.description: Spaces at the start or end of text are ignored.

options.name: blank_is_null
options.title: Blank text equals null
options.description: Empty text and a missing value count as the same.

blockOutputs.label: Records
blockOutputs.tooltip: One row per record: key, status (Added, Removed, Changed, Unchanged, Duplicate key), number and names of changed fields, row numbers.

blockOutputs.label: Differences
blockOutputs.tooltip: One row per changed value: key, field, old value, new value, numeric change.

blockOutputs.label: Fields
blockOutputs.tooltip: Per field: compared, key, only in old, only in new or ignored; types; values changed and share.
